skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Hydration Time
skins.content: MARTHE Sports Line New Arrivals/Hydration Time. Clothes specially designed for gym-heads, made from light and breathable materials. Enjoy unprecedented comfort and lightness during your training.
skins.quote: Just rehydrate between sets! Once you're all done, there are some cookies on the table as a reward!

skins.name: Campfire Cooking Smoke
skins.content: Vitafield [Camper] Series Classics/Campfire Cooking Smoke. Warm fur coat paired with red woven scarf for an inviting sight.
skins.quote: Where are you? Are you doing well? Can we picnic together again?
